candidate.definition_en: To take control of a place or people by military force, or to successfully overcome a problem or fear.
candidate.explanation_ar: تسيطر على بلد بالحرب، أو تتغلب على خوف أو مشكلة صعبة.

senses.definition_en: To take control of a country, territory, or people by military force.
senses.definition_ar: يغزو أو يحتل بلداً أو أرضاً بالقوة العسكرية.
examples: The Romans set out to conquer the known world.

senses.definition_en: To successfully overcome or defeat a fear, problem, or difficulty.
senses.definition_ar: يتغلب على خوف أو مرض أو مشكلة صعبة ويقهرها.
examples: She worked hard to conquer her fear of spiders.
Scientists are trying to conquer the disease.
The Romans set out to conquer the known world.
She worked hard to conquer her fear of spiders.
Scientists are trying to conquer the disease.
candidate.mnemonic: شبه 'King'.. الـ 'King' هو اللي بيعمل 'Conquer' للممالك.
